annotations.title: Check if a page is indexed

description: Asks Google's URL Inspection API about one page: whether it is indexed, the coverage state, last crawl time, the canonical Google chose versus the one you declared, and robots or fetch problems. Use for "is this page on Google?" questions. For on-page problems use page_check. Read-only; Google allows about 2,000 inspections a day per property.

site.description: The Search Console property to read. Accepts "example.com", "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com". Call list_sites first if unsure which properties exist.

url.description: Full URL of the page to inspect, including https://. It must belong to the site given.

name: inspect_url
title: Check if a page is indexed
